occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)

occurrences.finding: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being recited. occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home: There were 13 children in care; 5 children age 0-17  months and 8 children 18 months old and older.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: A completed admission form was not avaialble for two children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Children were observed napping on the sofa and blankets on the floor. Children must nap on a cot or non-absorbent mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §747.4303(a))

occurrences.finding: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules: The primary caregiver is not operating the child care home in compliance with Minimum Standards rules and laws. The center continues to receive deficiencies in relation to ratios, infant safety and record keeping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Comply with Child-care Licensing Law and Rules (26 TAC §747.207(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: The primary caregiver was observed hitting a child on the arm as a discipline method.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §747.2705(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, the following information was missing:  1. Two lacked the address of the emergency contact  2. Four lacked updated information regarding special needs and water activities.   3. One lacked a phone number for a person that pick up the child  4. One child was behind with immunizations
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Never exceed capacity of the home: The child care was over the capacity. There were 13 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Infants were observed sleeping in restrictive devices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Sleeping Equipment: The playyard was not sanitized prior to placing a different child in it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Sleeping Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths: Individual cloths/wipes are not being used to clean children during diaper changes. Children are being splashed with water from the sink while lying on the counter top.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths (26 TAC §747.3301(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home: The child care home was not in compliance with child/staff ratios. There were 9 children in care: 4 infants and 5 children 18 months old and older.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Children 18 months old to 4 years old were observed sleeping on the sofa and not a non-absorbent cot or mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §747.4303(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR: The assistant caregiver does not have CPR and First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR: The primary caregiver is not current with CPR and First Aid training. The training expired in November 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1007(5))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records: The following information was not on file for the assistant caregiver:  1. Date of employment  2. How the education requirement was met  3. Notarized affidavit  4. Pre-employment affidavit  5. Signed documentation that orientation to the home was completed  6. Photo identification
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records (26 TAC §747.901)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Two infants were observed sleeping in restrictive devices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: A child was observed being fed their bottle with it propped up by a blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §747.2319(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking: The home was not equipped with enough cribs/pack n' plays for each non-walking infants. There were four infants in care and only one pack n' play being used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking (26 TAC §747.2305(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: Several barrels that are collecting rain water are accessible to children. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3501(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads: Additional padding was in the play yard while being used by a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Play Yard and No Extra Pads (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Child-Initiated - Equipment/Materials In Reach: The home is not equipped with age-appropriate equipment for the children such as musical toys, blocks, trucks, dolls, shaking toys, rattlers, puzzles, etc.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Child-Initiated - Equipment/Materials In Reach (26 TAC §747.2104(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver received 25 of the 30 clock hours of required training for the August 2022-August 2023 training year. The caregiver will need to receive 5 clock hours of make-up training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The outside area contains many hazards such as lawn equipment, containers of gasoline, paint, bug sprays, car batteries and old tires. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: Children 4 years old and younger are not napping on a non-absorbent surface like a mat or cot. The children are napping on pallets on the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §747.4303(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Of the four children's records evaluated, two lacked a health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: Medications were accesisble to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3607(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area: The diaper changing surface is not being sanitized after each use. The primary caregiver is only using water to clean the diaper changing surface.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area (26 TAC §747.3307(d))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A child under the age of 2 was watching television.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: Diapers are being changed in an area where children play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: School-age children were playing random games on their electronic devices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The primary caregiver is not documenting that fire drills, severe weather drills, checks of the smoke and carbon monoxide detector are being done.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking: The infant is being placed on a pallet on the floor to nap and not the play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Non-walking (26 TAC §747.2305(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Children's records were reviewed and the following infromaiton was missing:  1.. Three lacked required infromation for an emergency contact.  2. One lacked the admission date.  3. One lacked authorization for emergency medical care.  4. One lacked the name of the school the school age child attends.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Bottles were observed not properly labeled with the child's first name and initial of last name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §747.2319(5))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: During the inspection it was observed that the two children who had diaper changes, did not have their hands washed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home: During the inspection the operation was out of ratio by 2 children. There was 8 children in care ages ranging from 4 months to 4 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - Registered Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1701)

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities: It was observed that children did not have planned activities. Throoughout the inspection children were observed watching television. There were no educational toys observed for children to play with, and there were only four teddy bears.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities (26 TAC §747.2101(a))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child: It was observed that the caregiver did not wash hands after changing two diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §747.3211(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: One out of 8 child records reviewed was missing admission information including immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children Adjusting Appropriately for Different Ages and Abilities: Children were repeatedly left unattended throughout the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children Adjusting Appropriately for Different Ages and Abilities (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the walkthrough two children( 4 months and 3 years) were found hidden in the restroom. Note: The children were removed from the restroom and placed in the daycare area.     It was observed that older children were sleeping in restrictive devices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Infant was observed in an restrictive device for a duration of an hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §747.2317(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Heating Devices Safe - Gas Appliances: Gas stove outside was observed with a small flame and there was a strong gas odor in the area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Heating Devices Safe - Gas Appliances (26 TAC §747.5301(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Fire extinguisher was observed not full.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: Primary caregiver was observed changing diapers in the area used for eating, napping, and playing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))

occurrences.finding: Outdoor Space Requirements - 80 Sq. Feet Per Child: The outside area does not have 80 square feet of space per child. The outside area has numerous tools for gardening, several large cooking equipments, plants, and refrigerators.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Outdoor Space Requirements - 80 Sq. Feet Per Child (26 TAC §747.4101)
